scope: Bounded acceptance of one automatic full-worker image deletion from the validated saved cleanup checkpoint
evidence_source: User-provided read_only_saved_automatic_cleanup_evidence output from authenticated Cloud Shell; no independent authenticated provider query by agent

acceptance.interpretation: The saved transaction confirms one ledger-owned old image was removed and absent in the controller's subsequent complete inventory read at that time; it does not establish fresh registry absence, reclaimed storage bytes, or billed savings

saved_cleanup.timestamp_interpretation: created_at and observed_at identify cleanup-plan creation and its baseline inventory observation, not deletion completion; the later readback time records retrieval of the saved transaction

helper_validation_scope: Validate the coordinator checkpoint and its current/rollback image pointers
Validate the cleanup ownership binding, plan hash, baseline, protected images, selection and saved progress
Require no active update campaign and a stable coordinator generation across the read
Publish allowlisted cleanup metadata without dumping the private state, plan, environment or credentials
evidence_limits: The report reads the saved transaction; fresh_registry_absence_verified is explicitly false

The controller records removed only after a full provider inventory read confirms absence and matches the baseline minus removed images; that is historical controller evidence rather than a new registry query by this readback helper
The two retained image pointers are not a complete current repository inventory
No exact deletion completion timestamp, reclaimed layer capacity or billed savings are supplied
Cleanup plan validity of 24 hours is not a fixed one-day image retention policy
This image-deletion case does not verify GCS build-source object expiry, Durable Object row cleanup, or an actual image rollback exercise
next_priority: Read the exact removed Artifact Registry version and retained versions without triggering another update or deletion
Read GCS build-source lifecycle settings and actual object-expiry evidence separately
Observe repository storage and actual project-filtered billed costs and credits in TWD
